site.name: O Elefante Fugiu
site.description: Short interactive stories from Portuguese history, tied to the map and to time.

about.title: About the project
about.description: Short, sourced stories from Portugal’s past, each tied to a real place you can visit. Meet the one-person project behind O Elefante Fugiu.

method.title: Method and sources
method.description: How I separate proven fact from legend: three labels, sources under every story, and how I handle dates, numbers, images, and mistakes.

report.title: Found a mistake?
report.description: Spotted a wrong date, name, or place in a story? Tell me, and I’ll check it.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.description: How you may reuse the texts, illustrations and code, what your browser stores, and which services see your IP address. No cookies, no ads.

map.title: Map
map.description: Explore Portuguese history on a map: filter stories by era or thread, then find your way to the spot where each one happened.

surprise.title: Surprise me
surprise.description: Not sure where to start? Get a random story from Portugal’s past in seconds.

footer.licenses: Project texts and illustrations: {content}, use in teaching is allowed. Code: {code}.

home.hook_title: In 1515 a king set a rhinoceros against an elephant. The elephant ran away.
home.intro: That is where the name comes from: O Elefante Fugiu, “the elephant ran away.” Stories from Portugal’s past, each a one-minute read tied to a place you can visit.
home.threads_intro: Pick a theme and follow it through the centuries.

notfound.title: The elephant ran away again. This page isn’t here.

report.lead: Even elephants sometimes lose their way. If a story has a wrong date, name, place or translation, let me know. I’ll check it, fix the text and update the date it was last checked.
report.what_hint: For example: the battle was on August 14, not the 15th
report.source_label: Where can I check this? (if you know)
report.source_hint: A link, a book, a museum label
report.email_label: Your email (if you’d like a reply)
report.note: Your message reaches my inbox through the FormSubmit service. I don’t store anything on the site (more in {{legal|Legal information}}). You can also write to me directly: {{email}}.
report.sent_title: Thank you! The elephant is already running to check.
report.sent_text: If you left your email, I’ll write back once I’ve looked into it.
report.failed: Could not send right now. Try again or write to me directly at
